Kate Chopin, Short Fiction.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/kate-chopin/short-fiction

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Kate Chopin, the author, died 1904 (Wikidata Q230476, P570 = 1904-08-22).

First publication of the text used: not stated as a year in the facts. The SE colophon says the collection 'was compiled from short stories written between 1890 and 1897 by Kate Chopin'. The country of first publication is not stated in the facts.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the stories were written between 1890 and 1897, and the edition's rights statement (quoted below) places the text in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the only person whose words are in the text, Kate Chopin, died in 1904. The text is therefore public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever the country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: 'Short Fiction was compiled from short stories written between 1890 and 1897 by Kate Chopin.'
- Wikidata Q230476 (Kate Chopin), P570 = 1904-08-22; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kate_Chopin
